description: Canonical PK/FK/relationship reference for all datasets in Package003_Healthcare v1.0.0-RC1.
relationship_to_package001: No hard foreign keys into Package001_Geography exist yet — state/district fields are free-text values ('Telangana', 'Andhra Pradesh', district names) rather than district_id references, because per-row district-level attribution was not independently verifiable for every entity in this release. Wiring these fields to Package001_Geography's state.csv/district.csv primary keys is tracked as future work (see acquisition_backlog.json).
relationship_to_package002: medical_colleges_telangana_andhra_pradesh.attached_teaching_hospital and government_hospitals_telangana_andhra_pradesh.medical_college_affiliation are free-text cross-references to each other (both within this package), not enforced foreign keys — a name may not match exactly between the two datasets since they were collected independently. No relationship to Package002_Education's data in this release.
